mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE_HIS(ROLE_ID, HIS_NO, STATUS, PAGE_ID, ELEMENT_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select ROLE_ID, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE_HIS where STATUS IN('E','D')) + 1 as HIS_NO, STATUS, PAGE_ID, ELEMENT_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE where STATUS IN('E','D')

insert into CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE_HIS(ROLE_ID, HIS_NO, STATUS, PAGE_ID, ELEMENT_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select ROLE_ID, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE_HIS where STATUS = 'E') + 1 as HIS_NO, STATUS, PAGE_ID, ELEMENT_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_ROLE_MODULE where STATUS = 'E' and WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
